title: Cosmic Eye Portal
description: A massive stylized cosmic eye dominates the surreal night sky, featuring a green iris with yellow lightning patterns and a black pupil. A pink unicorn with a flowing blue mane leaps from the left toward the eye while carrying a small rider, set against swirling green and purple energy waves above a patterned green landscape containing a small statue.
